messages:
rachel_fin: Hi team — Orionix flagged an unexpected set of overage lines that look like the same reserved commit usage was billed twice (reserved + burst) after a maintenance-led reassign. Total disputed = USD 2,740 across INV-2026-412 and INV-2026-413. Can we offer a provisional credit while we investigate?
devin_sales: cc @sam_platform @ana_revops Customer is concerned about payment hold. Need a quick ETA and tentative credit amount.
sam_platform: Need commit id and metering excerpts. Likely the rebalancer temporarily flipped tags to 'burst-fallback' which our billing pipeline treats as billable burst.
rachel_fin: Commit tag: rw-orion-q2-1. Metering snippet: ```
2026-06-17T21:44:02Z commit=rw-orion-q2-1 node=us-east-1a tokens=142K reserved=true
2026-06-17T21:44:10Z commit=burst-fallback node=us-east-1a tokens=18K reserved=false reason=maintenance
2026-06-17T21:44:28Z commit=rw-orion-q2-1 node=us-east-1b tokens=130K reserved=true
```
sam_platform: Confirmed — maintenance window had host detach that caused a brief fallback tag. I can run the attribution backfill to remap 'burst-fallback' events to the reserved commit if the host traces match.
nana_revops: (typo) @ana_revops: Provisional credit approval up to USD 2,750. GL: 5500 (SLA provisional credits). Hold reason: "pending maintenance attribution backfill". Please open ticket.
nana_revops: sorry for the double post, meant to tag @ana_revops.
nana_revops: Creating BLG-10021 and attaching invoice PDFs.
billing_bot: Ticket BLG-10021 created by rachel_fin. Status: pending-backfill. Assignee: sam_platform.
sam_platform: Backfill started. Reprocessed 6,832 meter events; 89% of disputed tokens map to rw-orion-q2-1. Proposed adjustment USD 2,608. Pushing reconciliation to BLG-10021.
metering_bot: Backfill audit upload: https://redwood.internal/ops/billing/BLG-10021/audit (includes host trace and mapping summary).
rachel_fin: Reviewed audit. Proposed final credit USD 2,608 looks right. Will wait for ana_revops sign-off before posting.
nana_revops: @ana_revops signing off on final credit USD 2,608. Finance to post credit memo and close BLG-10021. Please use GL 5500 for posting.
devin_sales: I'll notify Orionix with provisional credit note and ETA 48h. Thanks everyone.
billing_bot: BLG-10021 updated: provisional 2,750 -> final 2,608; GL 5500; ticket closed.
